title: Felix made procurator
summary: Jones dates Felix’s appointment. He prints the word “proculator”.
description: Jones dates Felix’s appointment. He prints the word “proculator”. The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 52 AD (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.note: pending CFAH reference (the CFAH series does not cover this period; no tier 1–4 date exists)

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 280 (PDF p. 315)
chronologies.note: The printed spelling “proculator” is kept in the quotation. Acts 23:24 names Felix the governor. Acts does not narrate the appointment.
